Variants.Content: Entry Jah Lys I consolidated the Targaryen dynasty with reconciliation and institutionalization. He and Queen Alexa toured the Seven Kingdoms, listening to the complaints of lords, churches, and ordinary people, and promoting reconciliation between the kingdom's laws, roads, inheritance practices, and the church. Later generations will call him a wise king Many aristocratic rituals, royal customs, and great council precedents derived their authority from his rule; to commoners, the good king's name was often attached to a road, a bridge, or a less onerous edict.
